When you examine a patient who has suffered an unfavourable fracture of the body of the mandible, you would expect the
Option A: anterior fragment to be displaced downwards by the action of the digastric muscle.
Option B: posterior fragment to be displaced anteriorly by the action of the lateral pterygoid muscle.
Option C: anterior fragment to be displaced backwards by action of the temporalis muscle.
Option D: posterior fragment to be displaced medially by action of the medial pterygoid muscle.
